### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning                                                          |
| ----- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*   | comfort, pleasure, convenience, ease, enjoyment, fun             |
| ~en   | *v.*   | to please, soothe, comfort                                       |
| ~a    | *psv.* | pleased, comforted, soothed                                      |
| ~an   | *adj.* | comfortable, comforting, pleasurable, pleasant, easy, convenient |
| ~un   | *adv.* | conveniently, comfortably, easily                                |
### Connotation
- sweetness
- relaxation
- entertainment
### Antonym
- **ksoman**
### Etymology
#### Glyph
inspired by 甘 except that the "sweet" part on the tongue is replaced by a fruit hanging off of a tree (which also gives a "shelter of comfort" to the person/mouth like [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Actions/shu\|shu]]).
#### Meaning
- kinda toki pona "suwi, musi"
- philosophical concept "Low-hanging fruit" (MT: tistenna l-bajtra taqa' f'ħalqek)
#### Sound
- *a priori:* m=comfort, an=bodily
- Related to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Body parts/ma\|ma]] (body; pleasures are temporary usually)
- Coincidentally sounds like "manna" (the biblical sweet sky bread).
